title: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: approved Field Service time updates project task progress
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts, integration controls, licensing and approval behaviour are supported. Its statement about work order financial summaries needs qualification because another Microsoft page now documents a Cost Summary that includes approved time.

claims.claim: Project managers can reproject task effort by updating Remaining Effort.
claims.quote: A project manager can reproject effort on tasks by updating the default **Remaining Effort** with a new estimate on the task.

claims.claim: Changing Remaining Effort recalculates the task's estimate at completion.
claims.quote: This update causes a recalculation of the task's estimate at complete (EAC), progress percentage, and the projected effort variance on a task.

claims.claim: Changing Remaining Effort recalculates task progress percentage.
claims.quote: This update causes a recalculation of the task's estimate at complete (EAC), progress percentage, and the projected effort variance on a task.

claims.claim: These execution calculations occur at leaf task level.
claims.quote: Because these calculations occur at the leaf task level, their impact rolls up automatically to summary tasks and the project root.

claims.claim: Effort tracking shows progress at the project root, summary and leaf task levels.
claims.quote: Tracking data in the **Effort tracking** and **Cost tracking** views shows the progress and cost consumption at the project root node, summary tasks, and leaf node tasks levels.

claims.claim: Cost tracking shows progress at the project root, summary and leaf task levels.

claims.claim: Approved field labour uses the same native project rules as time entered directly in Project Operations.
claims.quote: Task metrics such as effort completed, effort remaining, percent complete, estimate at completion, and schedule variance are calculated using approved field labor under the same native project rules used for time entered directly in Project Operations.

claims.claim: Project Approver Admin allows approval of all entry types, including entries not linked to a project.

claims.claim: Field Service > Settings > Features > Field Service Integration with Project Operations is the documented integration-toggle path.

2. On the **Features** tab, turn on the **Field Service Integration with Project Operations** toggle.

claims.claim: No automation operation for the integration enablement toggle is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: msdyn_fieldservicesetting Project Operations integration enable; Field Service Integration with Project Operations API toggle. Read install and searched the full msdyn_fieldservicesetting reference for project/integration: no matching setting column or operation.

claims.claim: Power Platform admin center > Manage > Dynamics 365 Apps > Dynamics 365 Field Service and Project Operations Integration > Install installs the integration package.
claims.quote:
1. Sign in to the Power Platform admin center.
2. Select **Manage** > **Dynamics 365 Apps** > **Dynamics 365 Field Service and Project Operations Integration**.
3. Select **Install** and follow the prompts.
